mechanism.name: Population mean with a miscalibrated three-level surrogate
generation_equations: The source assumes an observed fixed surrogate prediction Y_hat=Z. Export it as X1 with role auxiliary_prediction, on both labeled and unlabeled rows.

Two independent samples from the same population: source_n_labeled rows with observed Y and source_n_unlabeled rows with observed X only. R=1 in the first labeled block; Y_obs=Y there. R=0 in the remaining block; Y_obs=0 is a placeholder.

sampling.dependence: Independent rows, with within-row dependence specified by the equations.
sampling.predictor_provenance: The source provides a fixed stylized prediction Y_hat=Z on every row; X1 stores this observed auxiliary prediction. It requires no model fitting or training split in the DGP. Recalibration methods fit their map using labeled data and must specify their own splitting rule.

assumptions: Independent sampling units; labeled and unlabeled samples are independent draws from the same joint/marginal population.
Label availability is fixed by sampling design independently of generated values, corresponding to MCAR sampling.
The stated distributions, independence conditions and selected population functional define the target. Its numerical verification applies to the declared scenario.

properties.notes: One observed discrete prediction input. Conditional means -2,0,4 are nonaffine in its numeric levels 1,2,3. Conditional outcome variance equals one. effective_dimension counts inputs that determine the conditional response law, including an observed surrogate or the sole tail-dependent auxiliary variable; correlated extra coordinates may carry additional information. high_dimensional compares total dimension with source labeled sample size. Interactions marks a nonadditive response/probability map.

estimand.name: E[Y]
estimand.definition: Population mean of Y, aided by the observed discrete prediction.

truth.expression: Population mean of Y, aided by the observed discrete prediction.
truth.derivation: Average the three equally likely conditional means: E[Y]=(-2+0+4)/3=2/3. Independent integration of the three Gaussian component densities gives the same value.

adaptations: Select mu3=4 from Figure 6; keep source n=1000,N=9000.

Name the observed surrogate X1 to match the numeric table interface; its schema role is auxiliary_prediction. The surrogate is part of the specified sampling law and is available before target labels.
Represent independent labeled/unlabeled samples in a single table: all X columns, label indicator R and Y_obs. A zero on an R=0 row is a finite placeholder.
The generate argument n counts total rows. Source total yields exact source allocation; other n use nearest-integer ratio allocation with both groups nonempty.
Use local PCG64 random streams, with independent covariate and response-noise streams. Each row remains an independent population draw.
